name: Mitake Remi
source:
The principal of Toogami Private Academy who hires [url=/c130994]Masayoshi[/url] to handle the school's ever-increasing "flaming incidents".

She lost both her husband and daughter in a past accident.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1245143]Getchu[/url]]

She used to be classmates with [url=/c140450]Ruka[/url].
